scope: Implementation conformance and real-environment fault injection

scenarios.title: 核心跨机器异构协作
scenarios.given: Two enrolled machines and different Harnesses; native multi-agent disabled
scenarios.fault_or_change: None
scenarios.action: External Management/Route Agents explicitly submit binding and invocation commands for two external Agent instances in different Harnesses; those Agents decide to exchange request/response, review, integrate and finalize through Collaboration Packets
assertions: The system delivers and records the requested collaboration; it does not decide team composition, communication or next steps
required_evidence: Pinned Harness/Driver/OS/protocol versions and policy
Correlated domain events, command IDs and receipts
Relevant source/artifact/external-effect read-back
Failure injection and recovery trace with timestamps

scenarios.title: 用户退出
scenarios.given: External Management Agent has submitted an authorized durable goal and an external Agent Session is active or bound
scenarios.fault_or_change: Close UI and terminate MCP client connection
scenarios.action: Close UI and MCP client; continue already submitted operations while the external Session remains available, or preserve pending state and let an external Management Agent explicitly rebind a new Session before further reasoning
assertions: Submitted operations do not depend on client connection
No implicit Agent reasoning, new delegation or new WorkItem occurs after Session loss
New entry reconstructs current durable state
Further reasoning resumes only after an external Management Agent Session is available
required_evidence: Pinned Harness/Driver/OS/protocol versions and policy
Correlated domain events, command IDs and receipts
Relevant source/artifact/external-effect read-back
Failure injection and recovery trace with timestamps
